purpose: Authoritative-vendor manufacturing integration review adding Augmentir as discovery-queued. Current provider-owned Augmentir pages explicitly confirm OData and REST API availability, skills/workforce intelligence, digital work execution, UKG workforce-management integration and a scoped/audited Augie MCP surface. However, the reviewed public material does not publish the REST/OData authentication contract, endpoint/schema reference, pagination, rate limits, webhook/event contract, private-SaaS host model or read/write permission semantics required for spec verification. No credentials, customer data, write calls, agent actions or plant-network probes were used.

systems.name: Augmentir Connected Worker Platform
systems.evidenceNote: Current provider-owned Augmentir product and pricing pages explicitly list REST API and OData access, digital work instructions/workflows, skills management, workforce intelligence and integrations with enterprise systems. Provider-owned UKG material confirms a live integration joining UKG time-and-attendance, scheduling and workforce data with Augmentir frontline performance/skills context. Augmentir also advertises an Augie MCP interface scoped by site/line/data-domain using existing roles with tenant/tool auditing; WFM does not inherit that agent surface or any action authority. The reviewed public pages do not expose the REST/OData endpoint/authentication/schema/pagination/rate-limit/version contract strongly enough for spec-verified evidence.

requiredPermissions: dedicated least-privilege Augmentir API/OData integration identity once the current vendor technical contract is supplied
read only the approved worker, team, skill, training, work-execution, asset/issue and performance fields required by WFM workflows
bind the exact Augmentir tenant, site/line scope, regional/private-SaaS host and allowed data domains; no cross-customer credential reuse

deny workflow authoring, work assignment mutation, skill/training changes, user/role administration, AI-agent actions, MCP tool execution, external-system writes and industrial-control actions in the normal WFM connector
dataAvailableOrExpected: worker/team identity and organisational context exposed to approved integrations
skills matrix, proficiency and training/readiness signals
digital work-instruction/workflow definitions and execution evidence
worker performance/productivity context including task-level execution signals
quality, safety, maintenance and issue context captured through frontline workflows
asset hierarchy/activity context where configured in Augmentir
UKG-connected time-and-attendance, scheduling and workforce context in deployments using the documented partnership connector
reporting/analytics data exposed through OData and REST API surfaces
automationOpportunities: join Augmentir skill/proficiency evidence to WFM availability, absence and production demand to flag likely qualified-coverage gaps before schedules lock
combine work-execution and productivity signals with WFM labour cost to identify line/task labour-cost variance, bottlenecks and high-value redeployment opportunities
use maintenance/asset/issue context to route appropriately skilled available workers before downtime creates emergency overtime or agency demand
prioritise training for constrained lines or tasks using real execution/performance evidence rather than generic course completion alone
where a customer also uses UKG, reconcile UKG schedule/time data, Augmentir execution/skills evidence and WFM cost/outcome data to improve staffing forecasts and expose over/under-staffing
future event-driven or AI-assisted analysis may be possible, but MCP/agent actions remain outside WFM authority until a separate read-only tool contract and explicit customer approval are proven
savingsHypotheses: reduce overtime and agency labour by identifying qualified internal cover using skills plus real availability before a shift or maintenance event
reduce training and onboarding cost by targeting upskilling at tasks/lines where execution evidence shows the largest readiness constraint
reduce downtime and lost throughput by aligning maintenance/operator skills with active asset and issue demand
reduce overstaffing and understaffing by combining schedule/attendance information with task-level performance and demand signals

improve labour-to-output and labour-to-maintenance cost attribution by joining frontline execution evidence to WFM payable-time/cost data without treating Augmentir execution duration as payroll truth
reduce manual skills-matrix, training and frontline-performance reconciliation across sites once stable approved API/OData mappings are proven
dataGaps: Augmentir is not authoritative for employment contracts, leave balances, payable time, payroll rules, agency commercials or complete availability unless those values are sourced from an approved upstream WFM/HCM integration

public provider material reviewed does not publish the exact REST/OData base URLs, authentication flow, token scopes/roles, endpoint schemas, pagination, throttling, change tracking, webhook authentication or versioning policy
skills/proficiency/performance signals must not automatically grant regulated work eligibility; customer qualification policy and source evidence remain authoritative
task/workflow duration is execution evidence rather than payroll truth and may span breaks, offline work or multi-worker activity
private SaaS, regional hosting, customer-specific fields, offline synchronisation and late-event semantics require authorised tenant evidence

MCP exposes powerful contextual AI access and is not a trusted default ingestion/write route; tool scope, read-only behaviour, prompt/data boundaries and action denial would need separate certification
constraintsRisks: do not promote marketing/product-page API statements to spec-verified without a provider-owned technical API/OData contract or authorised tenant observation
REST/OData availability does not prove least-privilege read authority; successful authentication alone cannot promote evidence

Augmentir advertises bidirectional enterprise integrations, pro-code extensibility and agentic AI, so WFM must prevent integration credentials from inheriting workflow mutation, external-system write or agent-action authority
workforce performance/skills data can materially affect worker decisions; mappings require transparent provenance, purpose limitation, auditable qualification logic and customer-approved retention
private-SaaS and multi-site deployments may use different hosts, identity providers, custom fields or network paths; host/tenant changes must fail closed until reviewed
valueReview.nextDevelopmentAction: Obtain Augmentir's current provider-owned REST/OData technical integration documentation or an authorised sandbox/tenant integration pack. Verify exact regional/private-SaaS hosts, authentication and effective scopes/roles, tenant/site/line boundaries, endpoint schemas, custom fields, pagination/change tracking, rate limits, schema/version drift, offline/late updates, webhook/event support if any, and read-only denial of mutations. Reuse the existing REST/OpenAPI and OData profiles only where the proven contract matches. Keep Augie MCP/agent surfaces disabled unless separately certified as bounded read-only tools with explicit customer approval and no action authority.
